summary: Finer steps to locate last year's AGI.

micro_tasks.title: Search email for the 2024 tax PDF
micro_tasks.description: Search your inbox for the 2024 return or the e-file confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Found the 2024 return PDF, or confirmed it is not in email

micro_tasks.title: Check the IRS online account for AGI
micro_tasks.description: Log in to your IRS online account and open the prior-year transcript.

acceptance_criteria.text: 2024 AGI value located in the IRS account
